notes.title: 0.3.2 changelist Holiday Update
notes.notes:
- Added 3 new characters (Santan, Saljian and Biskut Halia)
- Some maps are now snowing.
- Updated start menu graphics
- Various bug fixes

notes.title: Quick bug and animation fixes for the previous version
notes.notes:
-Fixed some visual bugs
-Fixed issue with no host in a lobby
-Some animation fixes
-Fixed countdown bug after the game ends

notes.title: Big update for Halloween!
notes.notes:
- 8 new characters. Some characters are only available during our Halloween event.
- 5 new creepy buddies to accompany you.
- 1 new midnight map, Mansion.
- Voice chat (BETA). Communicate with other players with our new build-in voice chat.
- Improvements and bug fixes

notes.title: Update V0.2.9
notes.notes:
- Added new map : Forest.
- Added two new characters : Binjai (Police) & Gotosan (Robber).
- Added Localisation : English, Japan, Spanish, Bahasa.
- Added How To Play window for beginners.
- Fix some bugs and performance.

*Some translation may not properly/haven't translated. Please wait for more updates coming soon.
